ui.seed_hint: Place a card to begin. Different cards lead to different things.

aspect.money.name: Money

slot.work.name: Work
slot.work.desc: The daily grind. The first card you place decides how you go about it.
slot.study.name: Study
slot.study.desc: Searching for something among dusty pages.
slot.go_out.name: Go Out
slot.go_out.desc: Leave the room and walk the streets.
slot.work_extra.name: Aid
slot.work_extra.desc: Something extra. Sometimes it brings surprises.
slot.study_extra.name: Aid
slot.study_extra.desc: Bring something to help you think.
slot.go_out_extra.name: Companion
slot.night_extra.name: Companion
slot.night_extra.desc: Bring something along into the night.
element.health.name: Health
element.health.desc: You can still carry on. The body is everything.
element.coin.name: Coin
element.coin.desc: A few coins. Enough to last a little longer.
element.passion.name: Passion
element.passion.desc: An untimely fire. Once lit, nothing can stop it.
element.reason.name: Reason
element.reason.desc: You can still think clearly. Precious, and fragile.
element.lantern.name: Lantern
element.lantern.desc: An old lantern. Something seems to move inside the wick.
element.insight.name: Insight
element.insight.desc: A fresh understanding. It won't feed you, but it may be useful.
element.disease_flu.name: Chill
element.disease_flu.desc: You are ill. It will fade in time, but the days will be hard until then.
event.work_basic.name: Office Work
event.work_basic.desc: You spend another dull day at the office.
event.work_basic.result: The day ends and you collect your pay.
event.work_overtime.name: Overtime
event.work_overtime.desc: Your boss keeps you late with one more task.
event.work_overtime.result: You stay up late, earn a little more, and lose a little clarity.
event.study_basic.name: Reading
event.study_basic.desc: You open an old book, and something between the lines looks back.
event.study_basic.result: You close the book, feeling you have glimpsed something.
event.go_out_basic.name: A Walk
event.go_out_basic.desc: You wander the streets without purpose.
event.go_out_basic.result: You return carrying the smell of the outside.
event.night_walk.name: Night Walk
event.night_walk.desc: You carry the lantern into the night. Something watches beyond its light.
event.night_walk.result: You bring back something you should not have seen.
event.time.name: Time Passes
event.time.desc: The days go by, and something must always be paid.
event.time.result: More time passes, and its cost falls on you.
event.starved.name: Nothing Left
event.starved.desc: There is nothing left to give.
ending.starved.name: The End of the Road
ending.starved.desc: The money ran out, and then so did your strength. You did not see another spring.
